# fundr

> fundr is a New Zealand-based asset finance brokerage (FSP1007390) specialising in vehicle, truck, equipment and business finance for tradies, SMEs and business owners. Founded and run by Nick Sevta, fundr works with 15+ NZ lenders to arrange finance, with most decisions within 24 hours. Operates nationwide across New Zealand from Mairangi Bay, Auckland.

Last updated: 9 November 2026

fundr is an independent finance broker, not a lender — it takes each application to a panel of 15+ NZ lenders to find the right fit and structure for the client's business and situation. The service is generally free to the client because fundr is paid by the lender; if a fee applies, fundr explains it and agrees it before proceeding. Services cover vehicle finance (cars, SUVs, utes, vans, luxury/prestige vehicles), truck finance (prime movers, tippers, curtainsiders, crane trucks), equipment finance (construction, medical, kitchen, gym, warehouse and more) and general business finance (working capital, cashflow, business acquisition funding). Typical vehicle and equipment finance runs from $10,000 to $250,000 over 3 to 5 years, usually as a chattel mortgage (term loan), hire purchase or finance lease, with optional balloon payments. Clients deal directly with Nick Sevta throughout the process, from application to settlement.

## About the Broker

Nick Sevta is the founder, director and sole broker of fundr Limited, with 15+ years of commercial finance experience. His prior roles include NZ Country Manager at BOQ Finance, General Manager at flexicommercial (humm group), and senior roles at GE Capital, Wells Fargo and Bank of New Zealand. He specialises in structuring chattel mortgages, hire purchase and finance leases, and assessing serviceability and credit for NZ businesses.

- Contact: Nick Sevta, nick@fundr.co.nz, +64 21 102 3416
- Location: Mairangi Bay, Auckland, New Zealand (serves all of NZ)
- Registration: fundr Limited, FSPR number FSP1007390

## What We Finance

- [Vehicle Finance](https://www.fundr.co.nz/vehicle-finance.html): Business finance for cars, SUVs, utes, vans, fleets and luxury/prestige vehicles. Covers finance structures (chattel mortgage, hire purchase, finance lease), new vs used and vehicle age, dealer vs private sale, balloon payments, GST and FBT, and dealer finance vs using a broker.
- [Van Finance](https://www.fundr.co.nz/van-finance.html): Work vans, courier and delivery vans and fleets — HiAce, Transit, Sprinter, iLoad and more, new or used.
- [Ute Finance](https://www.fundr.co.nz/ute-finance.html): Any make or model work ute — Ford Ranger, Toyota Hilux, VW Amarok, Isuzu D-MAX, BYD Shark 6 and more. Includes structures, balloon payments and GST guidance.
- [Truck Finance](https://www.fundr.co.nz/truck-finance.html): Prime movers, tippers, curtainsiders, crane trucks and heavy vehicles. Includes structures, balloon payments, GST and Road User Charges.
- [Equipment Finance](https://www.fundr.co.nz/equipment-finance.html): Construction, medical, kitchen, gym, warehouse and other business equipment. Includes structures, balloon payments, GST, depreciation and Investment Boost.
- [Business Finance](https://www.fundr.co.nz/business-finance.html): Working capital, cashflow solutions and business acquisition funding.
- [Unsecured Business Loans](https://www.fundr.co.nz/unsecured-business-loans.html): Unsecured business lending options for NZ SMEs.
- [Ford Ranger Finance](https://www.fundr.co.nz/ford-ranger-finance.html): Finance for XL, XLS, XLT, Wildtrak and Raptor models.
- [Toyota Hilux Finance](https://www.fundr.co.nz/toyota-hilux-finance.html): Finance for SR, SR5 and Rogue, single/extra/double cab.
- [VW Amarok Finance](https://www.fundr.co.nz/vw-amarok-finance.html): Finance for V6 and 4-cylinder Amarok utes.
- [BYD Shark 6, Isuzu D-MAX & Triton Finance](https://www.fundr.co.nz/byd-isuzu-triton-finance.html): Finance for other ute models including BYD, Isuzu and Mitsubishi Triton.
- [Luxury Vehicle Finance](https://www.fundr.co.nz/luxury-vehicle-finance.html): Range Rover, BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Porsche — balloon payment structuring for business owners and directors.
- [What We Finance (overview)](https://www.fundr.co.nz/what-we-finance.html): Full summary of all asset classes fundr finances.

- [Get a Quote](https://www.fundr.co.nz/quick-quote.html): 60-second indicative quote and the main way to start an enquiry. Nick will be in touch within 1 business hour.
- [Check Eligibility](https://www.fundr.co.nz/check-eligibility-full.html): Quick eligibility check for NZ businesses.
- [Finance Calculators](https://www.fundr.co.nz/calculators.html): Free repayment calculators for vehicles, utes, trucks, equipment and business loans, plus a balloon repayment comparison. Indicative only, not an offer of credit.
